item.title: Harbor Bridge back open after costly repairs
item.description: The Harbor Bridge in Port Elm reopened to traffic on Monday morning after an 18-month repair project.

item.title: Tessera rover finds clay on Mars
item.description: The Tessera rover has found clay minerals in an ancient crater on Mars, mission scientists said on Tuesday.

item.title: School lunch program expands to all grades
Pelicans beat Hawks to take the title
item.description: The Port Elm Pelicans are regional champions after beating the Ridgefield Hawks 88 to 81 in Monday's final, a result that sent local sports fans into the streets.
